query:
SELECT ps.id as shoot_id, ps.title, ps.slug, pc.slug as cat_slug
FROM portfolio_shoots ps
JOIN portfolio_categories pc ON ps.categoryId = pc.id
WHERE pc.slug = 'profissional';
